root_cause: ProtoOAGetTickDataRes historical ticks are newest-first and delta-compressed after the first element. The implementation incorrectly rejected negative timestamp deltas and incorrectly treated later tick values as absolute raw prices.

sources.title: Open API ProtoOAGetTickDataRes
sources.fact: tickData is newest-first; first timestamp is absolute Unix milliseconds and later timestamps are time differences from the previous/current tick.

sources.title: Attain symbol data - historical tick data
sources.fact: Historical tick data is returned in relative format and must be transformed to actual symbol prices.

sources.title: ProtoOAGetTickDataReq Assistance
sources.fact: Spotware support states timestamp deltas are distances from the previous tick and must be cumulatively added from the first tick.

sources.title: Help me,About ProtoOAGetTickDataRes
sources.fact: Protocol example shows first absolute timestamp/price followed by negative timestamp deltas and small signed price deltas; relative values are applied cumulatively.

resume_safety.behavior: Existing V3 work directory is archived automatically on tool-version binding mismatch and capture starts clean.
